_about: The default camera of each place (Fable Nov 19, Part 2; Fable Nov 20: +4 degrees everywhere, the owner's decision; the player can pick Standard / +4 / +6 / +8 and Closer / Default / Further in Settings on top). pitch_bonus = degrees added to every camera angle preset (the camera looks down more); distance = how far the camera stands (1.0 = as everywhere, 0.9 = 10 % closer, 1.1 = 10 % further). To apply a choice from the contact sheets in docs/overnight_shots/nov19b/camera/, change the two numbers of that place here: nothing else. Read by ZoneCamera (world/look/zone_camera.gd).
